events.title: Build Your AI Recruiting Toolkit
events.description:
Build Your AI Recruiting Toolkit
ColorStack UW, the Claude Builder Club @ UW Seattle and Boardsweep are hosting a hands-on recruiting workshop for students heading into internship and new grad season.
Details
When: Monday, Nov 30, 6:00–7:30 PM

Where: Savery Hall 260 (SAV 260), University of Washington

Bring: a laptop and your resume (a PDF or Google Doc works)

Bring your laptop and your resume. We'll work through each step together, so you leave with a stronger resume, a list of roles that fit you and a plan for the next few weeks.
What we'll cover
Sharpen your resume with Claude. Paste in a real job description, see what it's actually asking for, and rewrite your bullets around what you've done.

Find internships that fit you. Connect Boardsweep to Claude, search open internships and new grad roles by field, city and visa needs, and build a target list with alerts for the companies you care about.

Prep for interviews. Use Claude to work out the questions the role you picked is likely to bring up, and practice your answers.

For attendees
Claude credits

Uber One credits

A free month of Boardsweep

Snacks after the workshop

Spots are limited. Once the room is full, new RSVPs join the waitlist in order, so RSVP early.

events.title: End of Year Social
events.description:
Open to current UW students only.
✨ one last time before the end of this year, cseed!! ✨
we've made it to the end of 2026!! 🥹 from new ideas and crazy projects to new friendships and unforgettable memories, it's been quite the ride. before we head into winter break, let's get together one more time to celebrate everything we've accomplished and all the memories we've made along the way 💗
what's happening:
🍕 FREE food, snacks, and treats (because what's a social without food?)

🎲 fun games, activities, and a little friendly competition

💬 catching up with old friends and meeting new faces

🫶 lots of time to hang out, relax, and just enjoy each other's company!

whether you've been part of cseed since day one or just joined us recently, we'd LOVE to see you there!! this community wouldn't be the same without you, so come celebrate with us before we wrap up the year 🥹
no experience, projects, or big ideas needed — just bring yourself and a friend!! let's make our last cseed event of the year one to remember 💌
DATE AND LOCATION: Wednesday, December 2nd, 5 PM-6 PM, CSE2 G01

events.title: WiB End-of-Year Happy Hour
events.host: MBA Women in Business Association at the University of Washington
events.description:
Join Foster Women in Business for our End-of-Year Happy Hour at Bale Breaker & Yonder Cider Taproom in Ballard. It’s a chance to reconnect, enjoy a few drinks, and spend some time together before everyone heads off for winter break. We’ll be covering drinks while our tab lasts!
And if you’re heading to Foster Game Day that evening, stop by for a drink beforehand. You can enjoy both events without missing out!
Want to add something creative to your evening?

We’re also offering an optional wreath-making workshop with Petal Baby Floral. You’ll get to create your own holiday wreath with all the materials and guidance provided. There are just 10 spots available, and WiB members will receive priority.
Happy Hour
WiB Members: FREE | Non-Members: $15
Optional Wreath-Making Workshop
WiB Members: $10 | Non-Members: $15
All materials provided and no crafting skills required. Sign up here: https://tinyurl.com/WiB-wreaths
Let's toast to everything we accomplished this year! 🥂

events.title: Pack Winter Market Social
events.description:
Join Pack Ventures founders, LPs, and friends of the fund for a festive winter market social at UW! Come by for a relaxed afternoon of winter market activities, good company, live music, tasty food, and drinks.
Bring the whole family and enjoy activities for all ages. 

Whether you’re catching up with familiar faces or meeting someone new, there’ll be plenty of time to mingle and soak up the winter market atmosphere.
We are happy to partner with the UW Alumni Association on the event venue!
Location: University of Washington Club - 4020 E Stevens Way NE, Seattle, WA 98195
Parking: Padelford Garage or Central Garage have self paid parking.
